subject: Trial allocation request for Beacon Health competitive pilot
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Trial allocation request for Beacon Health competitive pilot

Hi Monica / Karthik,

Quick request: Beacon Health (Emma Li, Director of AI Strategy) just confirmed a three-week competitive benchmark starting next week against MegabyteAI. They want to run a full inference comparison across their clinical summarization pipeline and have asked if we can provide trial credits + an extended trial window so they can include longer-tail latency tests.

Ask: 200k token eval credits and a 60-day trial extension (activation upon first API call). They specifically want priority inference during a two-week window in the middle of the benchmark.

Why this matters: Beacon is a mid-enterprise prospect in regional healthcare systems and is running an RFP with a clear procurement timeline (decision expected mid-June). If we win the benchmark it influences a multi-year committed deployment conversation.

Notes: I attached the RFP metrics they sent (Beacon_RFP_Metrics.pdf). Procurement will likely request an SOW and PO once they get internal approval. They also asked for SOC2 evidence and a DocuSign SOW template.

Can we approve 200k credits + trial extension? If not, what is the realistic alternative (e.g., 100–150k credits + 45-day extension)? Also need to know whether ops can provision the temporary priority capacity.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial allocation request for Beacon Health competitive pilot

Rafael —

Appreciate the context. Approve a conditional allocation: 150,000 token eval credits and a 45-day trial extension. Conditions:

- Credits are for evaluation only and expire 45 days from activation.
- Credits cannot be combined with other promotions or carried over.
- We need a clear mutually agreed evaluation plan (metrics to capture: latency p95/p99, token cost, quality delta) logged on the HubSpot deal (link to be added).
- Add the executive sponsor note in the email thread (helps CS for post-win onboarding).

Ops: please soft-reserve a two-week priority inference window (mid-benchmark) pending final date confirmation from Beacon. If Karthik can confirm capacity, we’ll finalize.

I'll authorize the credit promo code PILOT-BEACON-2027; finance will track as a promotional allocation against DEAL-2027-BEACON-1124. Rafael, please update HubSpot with the evaluation plan and attach Beacon_RFP_Metrics.pdf.

Monica
Monica Patel
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Li <emma@beaconhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, procurement@beaconhealth.com
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 08:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial allocation request for Beacon Health competitive pilot

Emma —

Thanks for the call earlier. Good news: we can offer a pilot allocation of 150,000 eval credits and a 45-day trial extension. Conditions and next steps below:

- Allocation: 150,000 tokens (promo code: PILOT-BEACON-2027).
- Trial window: 45 days from first activation.
- Priority inference: we can provision a soft-reservation for a two-week priority window (ops to confirm exact dates once you share the benchmark schedule).
- Required paperwork: procurement will need a simple SOW and a PO. I’m attaching our standard pilot terms (pilot-terms.pdf) and will follow up with a DocuSign SOW link.

Activation link (internal tracking): https://console.redwood.ai/pilot/activate?code=PILOT-BEACON-2027 (placeholder)

Please confirm the benchmark start date and procurement contact and we’ll push the DocuSign SOW and SOC2 attestation.

Best,
Rafael
From: Emma Li <emma@beaconhealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial allocation request for Beacon Health competitive pilot

Rafael —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for offering the allocation. A few clarifications from our side:

- Benchmark plan: kickoff Tuesday May 18, run for three weeks (May 18–June 7). The heavy inference window we want prioritized is May 25–June 7.
- Procurement: procurement@beaconhealth.com is the PO owner. They will want the SOW and list of deliverables; I copied them on the thread.
- SOC2: please include your most recent SOC2 attestation and a contact for security questions.
- Priority capacity: can you guarantee no throttling during the heavy window? If not guaranteed, can we get a performance SLA for the two-week period?

If the SOC2 doc and the DocuSign show standard pilot terms and we have a clear activation flow, procurement will move quickly.

Regards,
Emma Li
Director, AI Strategy — Beacon Health
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial allocation request for Beacon Health competitive pilot

Looping back with ops and security updates:

- SOC2: attached SOC2_Attestation_2026.pdf. Security contact: security@redwood.ai (we should give Emma that alias).
- Priority capacity: I coordinated with infra — we can provide a soft-reservation for May 25–June 7. We cannot offer a formal SLA for hosted tenants, but we will prioritize their traffic within the reserved window and provide tracing/latency exports for the time window. If Beacon needs a hard SLA, we should discuss a Dedicated/Reserved option.
- DocuSign: I created the SOW envelope and sent to procurement@beaconhealth.com (DocuSign ID: XYZ-998877). Rafael — please confirm HubSpot record (I linked it in related_links).

I’ll also capture the promo allocation in the finance tracker under DEAL-2027-BEACON-1124.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
